## ProofService.createProofRequestFromProposal() method

Create a [ProofRequest](./core.proofrequest.md) from a presentation proposal. This method can be used to create the proof request from a received proposal for use in [ProofService.createRequestAsResponse()](./core.proofservice.createrequestasresponse.md)

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
createProofRequestFromProposal(presentationProposal: PresentationPreview, config: {
        name: string;
        version: string;
        nonce?: string;
    }): Promise<ProofRequest>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter            | Type                                                 | Description                                              |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| presentationProposal | [PresentationPreview](./core.presentationpreview.md) | The presentation proposal to create a proof request from |
| config               | { name: string; version: string; nonce?: string; }   | Additional configuration to use for the proof request    |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[ProofRequest](./core.proofrequest.md)&gt;

proof request object
